exposure: Gestational weight gain (GWG) stratified as inadequate, adequate, or excessive
cohort: 211 obese women (BMI ≥ 30 kg/m²) with gestational or type 2 diabetes
finding: In obese diabetic women, inadequate gestational weight gain was associated with lower mean birth weights, lower rates of cesarean delivery, and lower rates of pregnancy-related hypertensive disorders.
mod_finding: Inadequate GWG was associated with lower rates of cesarean delivery.
birth_weight: Mean birth weight was lower in the inadequate GWG group
